title: Cross-Chain Delta-Neutral
description:
1] Mitigate Risks in Volatile DeFi markets:-
Delta Neutral Strategy helps to address potential losses in high volatility crypto markets through balanced negative and positive positions.

2]Enhancing Risk Management:-
It also enables proactive management of counter-party risks
how_its_made:
Risks and Challenges

Market Risk

Market fluctuations and sudden price movements can pose a considerable risk, requiring constant risk management.

Liquidity Challenges

Liquidation of underlying assets to maintain delta neutrality can be problematic, leading to potential counter-party risks and losses.
